findings: Verdict accepted. The single defect behind the review-2 rejection (unprovenanced 76.6016 in a text_render.rs test) is fixed by reusing one binding; the ratchet at the merge is no worse than parity-recovery 32684f81e. The Font.decode family resolution survives the merge intact: every G3 cohort is byte-identical to the G3 tip.

Pairs: the 16 menlo-font-name pairs that pass at the merge are carried from review-2.json with unchanged source and golden SHA-256 and re-measured on 6484bb7e0 (CLI and parity_perturbations agree). Residue stays out of the pairs list: chk_skin_helvetica_light (Helvetica-Light has no extracted advances), opus2_creole_decode_edges (T14.98 SansSerif spelling) and opus2_sk_empty (Java writes font-family="''") still fail, identically at the G3 tip; they remain named by review.json and review-2.json, so the record guard still covers them.

Integration 6484bb7e0 is a single-parent squash onto parity-recovery 32684f81e carrying review/opus-g3-recheck 4761d217b; 4761d217b is not an ancestor. Reproducing the merge with git merge-tree gives a clean merge everywhere except text_render.rs; the committed tree differs from that result only in text_render.rs. class.rs, sequence.rs, state.rs, svg.rs, usecase.rs, plantuml_metrics.rs, menlo_bi_fallback.rs and lib.rs are byte-identical to the G3 tip; face_cmap_tables.rs and bullseye.yaml are byte-identical to 32684f81e; creole.rs carries every changed line of both sides (multiset check, 0 missing). No file is deleted relative to either parent.

Ratchet fix: the test explicit_font_monospace_decodes_to_dialog now binds `let dialog_base = base(26.0, 76.6016);` once and derives the Menlo base from it (`let mut menlo = dialog_base;`), so the pre-existing literal is the only one. With the guard's own counting rule text_render.rs has 51 literals at 505999cac, 68 at 32684f81e, 52 at 4761d217b and 68 at 6484bb7e0; every rustuml-render file count at the merge equals 32684f81e, and the decimal_literal_ratchet listing is identical to 32684f81e (class.rs 383->578, deployment.rs 43->44, plantuml_metrics.rs 1053->1055, state.rs 53->61, text_render.rs 51->68). The fix is minimal and test-only. The 51->68 text_render.rs line itself is pre-existing at parity-recovery (G2/G6), not caused by this merge.

Conflict resolution: trim_text_for_emit, text_width_for_style and tab_stop_width keep G3's style_face call; style_face now takes bold/italic from effective_bold/effective_italic, which return the atom's own bits when Style::owns_font_configuration is set and base||style otherwise. write_text_element keeps G6's effective_bold/effective_italic/effective_underline. Changed-line multiset check: every G3 line is present except the three base||style lines replaced by effective_*; every parity-recovery line is present except two effective_* pairs subsumed by style_face. Probe (CLI, Rust only, 10 inputs: Menlo/Helvetica/Dialog under classFontStyle bold, italic, bolditalic, creole <b><i> and participantFontStyle bold, each with <img:absent.png>): the (Cannot decode) atom is plain monospace at the merge exactly as at 32684f81e (the G3 tip wrongly emitted font-weight/font-style on it); ordinary atoms keep base bold/italic and G3's Menlo widths exactly as at the G3 tip; classFontStyle bolditalic stays plain as at the G3 tip; Helvetica ASCII advances follow G2 (32684f81e).

Corpus: all 12,550 goldens give identical CLI whole-SVG match sets at the three trees (11,179 each, 0 losses); the only stdout byte change is edge-cases/edge_seq_title_with_variables, a %date() timestamp, with the same comparator result. golden_no_oracle passes at the merge, 11181/11251, baseline file identical to both parents. golden_pairs 10497/754/1299 at 32684f81e and the merge with identical per-directory failure lines. Perturbations (6,405 at the merge): CLI whole-SVG 3,726 / 3,708 / 3,771 at 32684f81e / G3 tip / merge, 0 losses against either parent. parity_perturbations gate failing paths 2,662 at 32684f81e, 2,640 at the merge: 25 fixed, 3 new, and the 3 new are menlo-font-name residue pairs (chk_skin_helvetica_light, opus2_creole_decode_edges, opus2_sk_empty) that do not exist at 32684f81e and fail identically at the G3 tip.

Element-level check over every changed stdout found 4 flags, all byte-identical to the other parent: alias_courier_trailing and alias_monospaced_case equal the G3 tip (17 -> 3 differences); c9a_sp_seqnote_mx_P equals 32684f81e (G2 Verdana cmap width 73.6011 vs Java 74.8071; the G3 tip's pre-G2 76.21 coincidentally rounds the note to the Java x, so neither matches); g2chk_helvetica_bold equals 32684f81e (30 differences vs 84 at the G3 tip). None is a composition artefact.

G3 cohorts are byte-identical to the G3 tip in every case (CZ 68, CN 46, CG 6, CQ 7, CR 14, CX 14), and CZ reproduces the registered predictions debbce39 68/68 (exit, stdout, stderr). Scores (32684f81e / G3 tip / merge, of Java-valid): CZ 24/51/51 of 68, CN 8/38/38 of 46, CG 1/6/6 of 6, CQ 0/7/7 of 7, CR 0/13/13 of 14, CX 3/11/11 of 14. G6 cohorts are byte-identical to 32684f81e in every case: CH 13/1/13 of 17 valid (20 cases, 3 Java crash pages), CM 15/4/15 of 40 valid (48 cases, 6 exit-0 crash pages and 2 exit 200), CS 25/3/25 of 25, CU 7/2/7 of 13 valid (18 cases, 5 exit-0 crash pages). G2 grok-g2-checker-heldout: 0/0/0 of 28 whole-SVG, as the G2 checker recorded; 10 stdouts change against 32684f81e (G3 family resolution) with no element-level loss.
